overview: This Senate resolution names the week beginning February 3, 2025, as National Tribal Colleges and Universities Week. Tribal colleges are accredited schools chartered by Native American tribes or the federal government; the resolution notes there are 34 of them on more than 90 campuses in 16 states, serving students from more than 230 tribes. It highlights their role in teaching Native languages and traditions and in offering higher education in remote, low-income areas, and it encourages the public to hold events showing support for them. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on January 30, 2025.
for: Supporters say tribal colleges play an important role in Native communities and deserve national recognition for widening access to higher education.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not provide any funding or change any law affecting tribal colleges.
